summary: Full E2E verification of Phase 2 (auth/JWT/orgs/teams/api-keys/RBAC) and Phase 3 (workspace projects/files-with-versioning/artifacts). Backend: 21/21 pytest passed (new file /app/backend/tests/test_phase23.py). Frontend: Registered a fresh user via /register -> auto personal org -> landed on /app; Overview shows 'Welcome back' and all 4 stat cards (overview-stat-projects/members/api-keys/your-role) with correct data (Projects=0, Members=1, API Keys=0, Your Role=Owner). Created a project via new-project-btn dialog, clicked the card, opened ProjectDetail. Uploaded notes.txt twice: first upload = v1, second (same filename) = v2. Files list shows only current (v2) row; version history panel (versions-<id>) lists both v1 and v2 with download links (visible in screenshot). Created a text artifact. Organization page: adding a non-existent email produced a friendly 404 error toast; team creation worked. API Keys: creation showed the full secret in new-apikey-banner, list shows only prefix, revoke works. Session persisted across reload (Bearer token in localStorage). Org switcher lists the user's 1 organization. Backend also confirms RBAC: an api-key with scope project:read can GET /orgs/{id}/projects (200) but is 403 on POST create; a non-member gets 403; invalid OAuth session_id returns 401.

design_issues.screen: Projects new-project dialog + API Keys revoke dialog
issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby/Description prop -> console warning (a11y minor)

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby={undefined} suppressor) to the DialogContent used in Projects new-project-btn and API Keys create/revoke dialogs to silence Radix a11y warning.

Docs alignment (non-blocking): review_request referenced testids 'stat-projects/stat-members/stat-apikeys/stat-role' and 'nav-projects' but the actual code uses 'overview-stat-projects/members/api-keys/your-role' and 'sidebar-projects-link' etc. All are present and testable; only the docs/testid names differ.
critical_code_review_comments: auth/router.py: add_member checks role validity BEFORE user existence, so a request with a bad role AND non-existent email returns 400 (role) instead of 404 (user). Acceptable, just an ordering nuance.
workspace/router.py upload_file: reads whole file into memory then uploads to storage; fine for MVP but should stream for large files.

auth/router.py refresh: sets new access_token cookie but does NOT return the token in JSON body, so a Bearer-only frontend won't be able to refresh silently. Login/register already return token+refresh_token, but /auth/refresh only returns {token}. Verify frontend AuthContext actually updates localStorage from that response body (it does: uses r.json().token). OK.
server.py _seed_admin only creates admin's Org on first insert; if admin exists WITHOUT membership (edge case), it isn't reconciled. Non-issue in practice.

workspace/router.py: no explicit check that org_id in path == an org the api-key/user actually belongs to beyond require_permission; deps.py handles it, but worth confirming ApiKey-scoped requests are also verified against the org_id (spot-checked via test_create_apikey_and_use with wrong-org call would be a good addition later).
